facts.text: Under the Penguin Tuition Promise, undergraduate tuition is fixed based on first enrollment and remains unchanged for four consecutive academic years.

sources.title: YSU's Penguin Tuition Promise | YSU
sources.quote: The YSU Penguin Tuition Promise assures a student and his/her family a fixed tuition rate for the pursuit of an undergraduate degree at Youngstown State University.

sources.title: YSU's Penguin Tuition Promise | YSU
sources.quote: A student's tuition rate is established based on first enrollment and remains unchanged for four consecutive academic years.
